title: TCP zero-window probe deadlock under ACK storm in high-throughput streaming proxy
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0666: TCP zero-window probe deadlock under ACK storm in high-throughput streaming proxy
Repository: `envoyproxy/envoy`
Category: `High-Throughput Network Protocols`
Target File: `source/common/network/connection_impl.cc`

#### Problem Description
Window update ACK lost in network buffer, while receiver waits for data and sender waits for window expansion.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Implement persistent zero-window timer with exponential backoff probe retransmission.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0666.py -q`
expected_invariant: Implement persistent zero-window timer with exponential backoff probe retransmission.
